body_lead: The Kerala High Court has directed the Travancore Devaswom Board (TDB) to accord the highest priority to crowd management, devotee safety, and sanitation ahead of the annual Mandalakala-Makaravilakku pilgrimage season. A bench comprising Justices Raja Vijayaraghavan V and K V Jayakumar emphasized that the welfare and convenience of the pilgrims must remain paramount throughout the upcoming festival period.
